items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Reverend Bronson. If you ever get a chance, listen to him.

ctx.x: Right, and there's a guy that comes on at 11:00, on Sunday night, and he comes on WDON. You should listen to him. He's on an hour, and he's got -- and he's a singer himself. He's -- I mean, the preacher. And, boy,he's got a great choir. Reverend Bronson. If you ever get a chance, listen to him.
